links.comparator_used: Standard double reading by two human readers
links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of DL combined with a human reader versus double reading in UK mammography screening
links.effect: Sensitivity noninferior: 67.0%, 65.6% and 65.4% for DL-1, DL-2 and DL-3 vs 67.4% for double reading (P < .001 for all). Specificity superior: 97.4%, 97.6% and 97.6% vs 97.1% (P < .001 for all).
links.quote: Combining the DL algorithms with human readers achieved noninferior sensitivity (67.0%, 65.6%, and 65.4% for DL-1, DL-2, and DL-3, respectively; P < .001 for all) compared with double reading (67.4%), and superior specificity (97.4%, 97.6%, and 97.6%; P < .001 for all) compared with double reading (97.1%).
